notes.subject: רוחי
notes.rationale: רוח i wanpela tok — win, win bilong lusim, Spirit; hia ‘pulim win bilong mi’ i holim piksa bilong נבע ‘gush forth’.

notes.subject: tense bilong אביעה
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS ridim olsem promis bilong bihain (‘mi bai…’); BSB ridim olsem past kauntring (‘sapos yupela i lukim…’).

notes.subject: ol man lapun meri long tingting
notes.rationale: Kalabu bilong senis: ‘bek long tok skelim bilong mi’.

translation: Bai yupela senis na bek long tok skelim bilong mi; lukim, mi bai pulim win bel bilong mi i kamap long yupela, mi bainim olgeta ol tok bilong mi long ⟨את⟩ yupela.

tokens.gloss: bel bilong mi i kamap long yupela
